usedFor: Frappe stores business records, and “Create Document” adds a new one when something happens elsewhere.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in Lemon Squeezy, then “Create Document” in Frappe
bestTemplate.why: Every new order gets its own record in Frappe, so nobody types it in.

watchOut: Automations run on an app event or a schedule, so check which one starts “Create Document”.
